rows.grounds: relative pronoun referring to the goddess

items.question: By what act is the addressed goddess identified as the one praised by the gods?
premises: A certain female agent delighted the gods.
That very agent is identified with the addressed goddess.
The addressed goddess is praised by the gods.
items.inference: Because the goddess who delighted the gods is the very one addressed, her praise by the gods is grounded in that act of delighting them.
items.plain_english: She who delighted the gods is none other than you, the one praised by the gods.
